$comment: Every allowed exception to a boundary rule (spec 008 T035, re-based by spec 009 T050). Adding one needs a reason and a plan.md Complexity Tracking row.

exceptions.reason: Its only import is type-only, so it needs no Electron or Node. Typewriter is hidden on Mobile; moving the file to the SDK would be a Desktop refactor Mobile does not need. plan.md, Complexity Tracking (FR-015).

Cloud library linking (Desktop-only feature, flag-gated and not offered on Mobile) imports the host-adapters services from a shared hook; moving the hook behind a platform adapter would be a refactor outside spec 009. It was already reachable from the Mobile UI graph before the move (check-mobile-ui-graph notes it).
